content.comment_body: Does [product_name] PLC have digital input modules that support both sink and source configurations? If so, which module offers this feature? I need to connect 8 digital inputs as sink type and 8 as source type. Please advise.

Hello, From my understanding, [product_name] by itself does not support both types; it typically accepts source inputs only. You could use 8 relays to condition your sink inputs to work with your program. Please note, you are limited to 24 inputs.

Alternatively, you might place a resistor of around 1000 ohms between the positive terminal of your power supply and your digital input. Your sensor should connect between the digital input and the negative supply, allowing the use of sink-type sensors.

Hi, You could use a [product_name] module like 24RC or 24RCo, which supports both 24V DC and 24V AC power supplies. Whether you use sink or source types depends on your wiring setup, including the power supply and input connections. The [product_name] DM8 24R module also allows for this configuration. Hope this information is helpful.
